notes.title: Another big update! Full Tutorial and new features added.
notes.content:
ADDED FEATURES:Full Tutorial!
Blast off in style with a full tutorial, walking you through the basics of the engine and crew panels.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45491531/3eeed273bea5d0d4afb2113478ea7bdb75a4c775.png"]
Codex Manual!
The Codex now houses a manual with video-enabled tips and hints to help you get to grips with your rocket.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45491531/bddc565918b26e094e3620cffb725e87be6d1db0.jpg"]
RPM Limiter!
The RPM limiter has been added - not only does it help keep framerates at acceptable levels, but you can use it to gain extra Power or Glory for your [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45491531/9f78a5e59a5d882f3f1f1051e95ae78796e912fe.jpg"]
Fancy New Mouse Cursors!
Glory approved mouse cursors now adorn your screen.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45491531/e671e766b0455ff04e2d23cc5b2813ddef27fd2c.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45491531/1890e86f3755785e891f2d0deaa9a9f9d379c7f9.png"]


No more hover!
Info panels and popups have been moved to use a right click to open instead of opening on hover. This should allow for easier movement around the engine - and also allows for interesting new possibilities in the engine like the new synergy lines that will appear when you hover over an item!


Fixes:
(hopefully) fixed issues with the game restarting with wonky stats and spawns after a failed or abandoned run

Fixed the fail screen text not showing you where you were en-route to

A lot minor stability fixes

Many others (Lost my notes during development, whoops)

notes.title: HUGE demo update! Rebuilt from the ground up (to space!)
notes.content:
This is a gigantic update - probably the largest the demo will see!



I've reworked almost all systems in the game from the ground up - the back-end, boring stuff, and the front-end, fun stuff!



Fuel items have been changed to use four major stats - Power, RPM, Heat, and Efficiency. Now, rather than worrying about whether an item has any multipliers to individual stats, it's all tracked with Efficiency!



To go with this, I've reworked all fuel items! There are a bunch more available in the demo, and they all have cool new effects.



Alongside this, there are a whole bunch of new features. The Crew Panel is now it's own, fully fledged UI system. Choose whether to place crew on the top or bottom deck, with different effects for where they're placed. Hire and promote using the new Recruitment Tokens - but beware, crew will be unable to work while training for promotion!



The Shop panel is now separated from the end-phase screen. Buy tokens and bonds any time you like! I hope this'll open a lot more opportunities for strategy.



There's also the brand new Tinker panel. Upgrade fuel items with your glory!



Oh, and did I mention? The rocket and all background content is now fully 3D, so you can finally see your ship doing the flips and tricks that your glorious journey deserves.



Check all this out, and more. The demo is available now!

notes.title: Patch 1.4.2 released!
notes.content:
Quality of Life:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45491531/0d1586e1fa7130aecf7b4baa90e8c2b0703b5274.gif

- There is now a little animation to show which items are synergising - it'll play when you place an item, and at the start and end of a boost!

- I've reworked some of the code in the background which should mean a bit less stuttering when the engine is going really fast! Hopefully I've not broken anything else alongside it.

Bugs:

-fixed continuing a run being broken after the tutorial update

- made the decimals on the 'visual speed' screen work properly

notes.title: Demo v1.4 - Tutorial added!
notes.content:
Tutorial added!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45491531/0613cf37964bb7ac574b59441c3887df2653e550.png
- You asked, and Glory answered. There's now a full tutorial in the game as well as the existing engine manual, so you can get a full walkthrough on how things work. The tutorial should take around 10-15 minutes to complete.

Quality of Life

- There is now a panel at the start of the game to choose between running the Tutorial, or from 3 different difficulty modes. There's only Cadet mode in the demo so don't get too excited!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45491531/d8583dd3e5e7a48fe33a5b2b35503157ff1902f0.png
- There's now an extra panel when you hover over the stats in your info box, so you can see better how your item is getting bonuses!

[img max-width = 200px]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45491531/41454d5bed3fa181fe9e5e7bb05dc0dc50851ac2.png
- There's now additional info in the distance panel - not only can you see how far you have remaining to your next destination, but distance travelled since your last destination and how far you managed to go in your previous boost!

- Numbers have been 'humanized' - it'll be easier to figure out if you've got a million Space Units left to go instead of a measly hundred thousand.

- The boost counter now updates when you press the ENGAGE button, rather than at the end of the boost. I noticed some people were getting false hope they had a boost left!

- Behaviour of the icons on item effects has been changed so they should only show when relevant to the item effect.

- Made it so crew members like the Woodsman add to item's scores in a more intuitive way, so you can track how much bonus they're giving to their item.

- You can now see fire accumulate behind the Power and RPM panels when you are sending enough points to them! (This was in the previous mini update, but I didn't make a post about that so here you go).

Bug fixes

- The Hardliner now destroys wood and organics, as well as vegetables.

- Stopped the info box going off the top of the screen if there was too much info to show.

- Resuming a run after quitting or abandoning now keeps the permanent upgrades that were on items.

- Stopped items that were getting a permanant stat bonus also gain a temporary bonus for the first boost they were running.

- Lots of other little fixes and tweaks!

notes.title: Demo v1.32 is live!
notes.content:
Quality of life:

- levels get exponentially further away in endless mode

-adjusted labels to make power and RPM a little clearer on item popups

Bug Fixes:

- stopped supply box closing when moving an item from the stock to the engine

-stopped you from being able to sell back restock and delete tokens in the shop that were held before the shop opened

-made the crew correctly show "x" instead of "%" if they add a x bonus

- items that absorb items they destroy will now properly absorb the permanent stat boosts of the destroyed items

-fertiliser is now 'rare' instead of 'uncommon'

-fixed bug when clicking and holding delete would use multiple delete tokens

-fixed bug where item effects given by crew would persist after abandoning a run

-added a blocker to stop accidentally picking items while the supply panel is restocking

notes.title: Second Big Demo Update!
notes.content:
Quality of life changes

Keep the feedback coming! I've added two new features that should make life in the void a little easier:

VISUAL SPEED:
There's now a little toggle on your data panel that will let you adjust the game speed from 0.25x to 2x.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45491531/4daacb3b0ed8a72f38c11c62cfe3f9fffe5d6111.png

SECONDARY TASK VISIBILITY:
I've added an extra bit of data that will show you your secondary tasks when you're looking through the salvage counter. No more having to moving between screens to see what you want to achieve!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45491531/2fa12781f1187009c77b1c23bceaa3598d5f38d6.png

DISCORD LINKS:
I've added some more discord links throughout the demo. If you want to join the discord, I'd love to hear your stories of glory, bugs you find, or suggestions you have for the game!

JOIN THE DISCORD NOW!

Bug Fixes

- Fixed an electrical bug that would cause electrical items to build up power and speed faster than anticipated! I've also nerfed the batteries slightly (Sorry Batteryheads)

- Fixed some visual glitches around the UI.

- Fixed some other little behind the scenes bugs.

notes.title: First Demo Update!
notes.content:
Quality of life changes

Thanks to some amazing feedback, I've updated the UI to be a little clearer when you're dragging around your fuel items to the engine. The engine will now highlight the segment or ring that's affected by your current item, and items that will either be affected by your held item, or will affect your held item, will be highlighted in the engine.

Previously:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45491531/bef177806fc21b00837a75052608f4cbaa9cfff3.png

Now:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45491531/a879f01238162a96e69be6647c5b453e04037388.png


- You can now successfully FAIL in endless mode. I left boosts unlimited in the original demo, but it led to some players feeling as if they were missing something by never being challenged.

- I've added a little reminder to check out the engine manual for new players. If you've already played the demo, this probably won't appear - but do read the manual anyway!



Bug Fixes

- Items in the stock will now not count as triggered when they have effects that trigger after x boosts.

- Stopped items flying off occasionally when dropped in strange places.
